title: Android foreground-service types and special-use subtype

freshness.volatility_notes: Recheck foreground-service type requirements when Android target SDK changes.

confidence.rationale: Official Android documentation for foreground-service type declarations and special-use subtype metadata.

claims.claim: Android 14 and later requires foreground services to declare an appropriate service type and its permission; specialUse is intended for valid foreground-service cases not covered by other types and uses a manifest subtype property.
